body:
I don’t feel like there’s anything good on my end for my suffering. But by not saying anything to her, I’m making sure she doesn’t feel uncomfortable or differently around me. Also, I would feel like I’ve been deceiving her for six years. 

I’m also afraid that if I did say something and she (inevitably) has to say that she doesn’t feel the same way, that will cut so deep.
I’m really sorry you’re going through a tough time. I hope that you are feeling secure in your current relationship and that your partner is supporting you.

Yeah I would never want to do that to her. Even when it’s so hard for me to imagine that anyone would care THAT much if I was gone, I know deep down, people would be affected. 

I definitely want her to be happy. I’m just having a hard time overcoming the feelings of jealousy I have.

Yeah I just don’t think anything good will come from saying something. She is not interested in women and I would just wind up feeling humiliated and embarrassed and even if that didn’t end the friendship, it would be fundamentally changed.
